pipeline_name: Sindh University to FJFC Offtake Loopline

validity.recommendation: No spec action needed. Existence and spec are confirmed by SSGC's own network table: https://www.ssgc.com.pk/web/?page_id=5597 (verified OK/200, contains 'FJFC') lists, under 'A1 Indus Left Bank Pipeline System': '24" dia. x116 Km loopline from Sind University to FJFC Offtake' — 60 mmscfd. That is an exact match on Diameter (24), LengthKnown (116.0) and Capacity (60.0 MMcf/d). This is the SSGC asset register flagged loudly on P4015 — same document, independently naming this row too.
validity.researcher_notes: See P4015.json validity entry for the full document context; not repeating it here beyond the row-specific quote above.

validity.recommendation: Leave StartYear1 blank / UNRESOLVED — do not backfill with the FJFC plant's 2000 start date. A human with SSGC investor-relations or PSX capex-disclosure access, or an OGRA licence-amendment filing search, is the next lead if this needs to be closed rather than left open.
validity.researcher_notes: FJFC = Fauji Jordan Fertilizer Company, the Bin Qasim/Karachi fertiliser complex later renamed Fauji Fertilizer Bin Qasim Limited (FFBL) in 2003. Multiple independent sources (Pakistan & Gulf Economist, 'In the prime of life', pakistangulfeconomist.com/2022/01/31/in-the-prime-of-life/; Grokipedia's Fauji Fertilizer Company page) agree the plant 'commenced commercial operations on January 1, 2000.' I deliberately did NOT use 2000 as StartYear1 for this row: this is a LOOPLINE (per the brief's own framing) laid to add capacity alongside an existing supply line to the same offtake, so its commissioning is a later capacity-expansion event, not the same date as the original plant start-up or the original (non-loop) supply pipeline. No source found names the loopline's own construction/commissioning year specifically — searches for 'SSGC loopline Sindh University', 'FJFC gas supply agreement history', and the FFBL VIS credit-rating report (docs.vis.com.pk/RatingReports/OP_00342001004_0003420.pdf, which confirms an SSGC gas-supply agreement to FFBL running through December 2025 but gives no construction-history dates) turned up nothing pipeline-specific. UNRESOLVED for StartYear1 is the correct outcome here, per the protocol's explicit guidance on field/plant dates vs. pipeline dates.
